hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Chief of Staff under Javier Milei, resigned amid allegations of illicit enrichment and corruption. His departure follows months of scrutiny over undeclared assets, luxury trips, and misuse of public resources, sparking a government reshuffle with Diego Santilli as his likely successor.
hotspots.affect: This scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its erosion of Milei's anti-corruption narrative, internal power struggles, and the high-profile nature of Adorni's role, which symbolized the administration's reformist agenda.
